helpTexts.timestampColumn: DateTime column or expression that is part of your table's primary key.
helpTexts.timestampColumnSpan: DateTime column or expression defines the start of the span
helpTexts.defaultSelect: Default columns selected in search results (this can be customized per search later)
helpTexts.serviceVersion: Identifies the running release of a service. Defaults to the OpenTelemetry service.version resource attribute. Point it elsewhere if your release identifier lives in another attribute - under GitOps it is often the container image tag. If services in this table use different attributes, fall back across them: coalesce(nullIf(ResourceAttributes['service.version'], ''), nullIf(ResourceAttributes['container.image.tag'], '')).
helpTexts.severityNumber: Expression for the numeric OpenTelemetry severity (1-24), usually the SeverityNumber column. Leave blank if the table has no such column.
helpTexts.eventName: Expression for the OpenTelemetry log event name, usually the EventName column. Leave blank if the table has no such column.
helpTexts.displayedTimestamp: This DateTime column is used to display and order search results.
helpTexts.implicitColumn: Column used for full text search if no property is specified in a Lucene-based search. Typically the message body of a log.
helpTexts.knownColumns: For Distributed table sources whose target tables have non-matching column sets. Provide a list of columns supported across all target tables; it is used instead of SELECT * when fetching full row data (e.g. the row side panel). Leave blank to select all columns. This should be a comma-separated list of column names - do not include non-column expressions or aliases.
helpTexts.highlightedRowAttributes: Expressions defining row-level attributes which are displayed in the row side panel for the selected row.
helpTexts.highlightedRowAttributesTrace: Expressions defining row-level attributes which are displayed in the row side panel for the selected row
helpTexts.highlightedTraceAttributes: Expressions defining trace-level attributes which are displayed in the trace view for the selected trace.
helpTexts.correlatedMetricSourceLogs: {{brandName}} Source for metrics associated with logs. Optional
helpTexts.correlatedTraceSourceLogs: {{brandName}} Source for traces associated with logs. Optional
helpTexts.correlatedLogSourceMetrics: {{brandName}} Source for logs associated with metrics. Optional
helpTexts.correlatedLogSourceTraces: {{brandName}} Source for logs associated with traces. Optional
helpTexts.correlatedSessionSourceTraces: {{brandName}} Source for sessions associated with traces. Optional
helpTexts.correlatedMetricSourceTraces: {{brandName}} Source for metrics associated with traces. Optional
helpTexts.correlatedTraceSourceSessions: {{brandName}} Source for traces associated with sessions. Required
helpTexts.sampleRate: Column or expression for upstream sampling weight (1/N). When set, aggregations (count, avg, sum, quantile) are corrected for sampling. Percentiles use quantileTDigestWeighted, which is an approximation -- exact values may differ slightly. Leave empty if spans are not sampled.
helpTexts.spanEvents: Expression to extract span events. Used to capture events associated with spans. Expected to be Nested ( Timestamp DateTime64(9), Name LowCardinality(String), Attributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String)
helpTexts.spanLinks: Expression to extract span links. Used to capture links from a span to spans in other traces. Expected to be Nested ( TraceId String, SpanId String, TraceState String, Attributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String) )

materializedViews.title: Materialized Views
materializedViews.help: Configure materialized views for query optimization. These pre-aggregated views can significantly improve query performance on aggregation queries.
materializedViews.metadataHelp: Configure materialized views for fast field discovery and value autocomplete. These pre-aggregated tables speed up filter loading and search suggestions.
materializedViews.granularityTooltip: The granularity of the timestamp column
materializedViews.minimumDateTooltip: (Optional) The earliest date and time (in the local timezone) for which the materialized view contains data. If not provided, then {{brandName}} will assume that the materialized view contains data for all dates for which the source table contains data.
materializedViews.dimensionColumnsTooltip: Columns which are not pre-aggregated in the materialized view and can be used for filtering and grouping.
materializedViews.inferred: Partially inferred materialized view configuration from view schema.
materializedViews.inferFailed: Unable to infer materialized view configuration.
materializedViews.preAggregatedColumnsTooltip: Columns which are pre-aggregated by the materialized view

minAutoGranularity.label: Minimum auto granularity
minAutoGranularity.help: Floor for 'auto granularity' on charts querying this source. Set this to your metrics' scrape/report interval to avoid sparse-looking charts on short time ranges. Doesn't affect an explicitly chosen (non-auto) granularity.
minAutoGranularity.promqlHelp: Floor for 'auto granularity' on charts querying this source. Set this to your metrics' scrape interval to avoid sparse-looking charts on short time ranges. Doesn't affect an explicitly chosen (non-auto) granularity. $__rate_interval is also sized from it, assuming a 15 second scrape interval when no minimum is set.

useTextIndex.label: Use Text Index
useTextIndex.help: Whether Lucene-based searches should emit hasAllTokens() when searching the implicit column. "Auto" (the default) detects a covering text index from skip-index metadata at query time; "Force enable" always emits hasAllTokens(), and is useful when querying a table using the merge table engine; "Force disable" falls back to hasToken().
